title: OpenTelemetry: Instrumentation
subtitle: Spans are step one; control and data planes make telemetry reliable and operable.

panels.heading: The first-spans trap
panels.caption: First spans land; teams pause. Identity drift and head sampling starve tail policies.
panels.note: Milestone hides schema churn, propagation gaps, and starved tail decisions.

panels.heading: Control and data reality
panels.caption: Shared identity, schema discipline, and safe head+tail sampling govern signal value.
panels.note: Place collectors near apps; use gateways to normalize and enforce per-tenant limits.

panels.heading: Operate: verify and measure
panels.caption: Continuously test propagation, watch queues and exporters, and set actionable SLOs.
panels.note: Compare 5xx to error traces; tie alerts to exporter success and queue depth.

strip_title: Build an operable OTel control + data plane
strip_caption: Go beyond first spans: standardize identity, sample safely, harden pipelines, and verify.

steps.label: Verify and set SLOs
steps.detail: Test propagation; alert on delivery gaps
